name: kodapdf
subtitle: PDF Tools & Converter
description: All-in-one productivity suite to convert, compress, merge, split, OCR, protect, and edit PDF documents.

interface.subtitle: PDF Tools & Converter
interface.longDescription: KodaPDF is an all-in-one productivity suite to convert between formats (Word, PDF, Excel, PPT), compress, merge, split, extract OCR text, and protect PDF documents.

positive.description: Convert an existing Word document (.docx) to PDF format
positive.prompt: Please convert this Word document to PDF: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: The model calls convert_document with file_url and target_format='pdf', then presents the completed job status and downloadable PDF link.

positive.description: Compress a PDF file to reduce its size for email or web
positive.prompt: Can you compress this PDF file to make it smaller? https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: The model invokes compress_pdf with file_url and recommended compression level, returning the reduced file download link.

positive.description: Merge two PDF documents sequentially into a single consolidated PDF
positive.prompt: Please merge these two PDF files into one: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf and https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: The model calls merge_pdfs with the list of two file URLs and returns the merged PDF download link.

positive.description: Extract readable text content from a document using OCR
positive.prompt: Extract the text from this document using OCR: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: The model invokes extract_text_ocr with file_url and displays the extracted text content to the user.

positive.description: Lock and encrypt a PDF document with a user password
positive.expected_behavior: The model calls protect_pdf with file_url and password, providing the download link for the encrypted document.

negative.description: General conversational or factual question unrelated to documents
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia and what is its population?
negative.expected_behavior: The model answers the question about Canberra directly without invoking any KodaPDF tools.

negative.prompt: Write a Python script to sort an array using quicksort.
negative.expected_behavior: The model provides the Python quicksort code directly without calling any KodaPDF tools.

negative.prompt: Generate a watercolor painting of a serene mountain landscape at sunset.
negative.expected_behavior: The model responds creatively without attempting to run document conversion tools.
